summary: Backend-only iteration 3 testing focused on the new POST /api/auth/google/session endpoint plus regression sweep (phone OTP, admin login, events list, application + REAL Razorpay create-order, admin endpoints). 14/14 tests passed. The new Google OAuth endpoint correctly returns 400 on missing/empty/whitespace session_id, 422 on missing body key, and translates upstream 404 from Emergent session-data API into HTTP 401 with detail 'Invalid or expired Google session' — never 500 (verified in backend logs). Phone OTP mock continues to work (test_code='123456' returned by /auth/phone/start, /auth/phone/verify issues JWT + participant user, /auth/me returns matching user). Admin login still works with admin@aleeclub.com / Admin@123. /api/events returns the seeded list. With real Razorpay test keys configured, POST /api/payments/create-order returns mock=false and a real order_id starting with 'order_' (verified live, e.g. 'order_RV...'). Admin endpoints /api/applications and /api/admin/users return 200 and do not leak password_hash. No backend regressions detected. The Google OAuth backend integration is wired correctly; only the real Google session round-trip is untested (no test Google account, as expected per request).
action_items: Frontend Google OAuth flow (auth.emergentagent.com redirect → fragment session_id → POST /api/auth/google/session) was NOT exercised end-to-end because there is no test Google account available — main agent should manually verify on the running Expo app with a real Google sign-in once.
Consider adding rate limiting on /api/auth/google/session and /api/auth/phone/start to prevent abuse (currently unbounded — non-blocking, future hardening).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:204-277 — /auth/google/session correctly maps upstream HTTP errors to 401 (not 500), strips _id and password_hash from response, sets auth_provider='google', and upserts by email. Good defensive coding.

server.py:228-230 — bare 'except Exception' for httpx errors raises HTTP 500 'Failed to verify Google session'. This is acceptable for transport-level errors, but a network failure to Emergent would surface as 500 to the user — could be 502/503 instead. Non-blocking.

server.py:289-328 — phone/verify creates a user keyed on phone with a pseudo-email '<phone>@phone.aleeclub.local'. If the same phone is later used for Google login, the email mismatch means the records won't merge. Edge case, not blocking for current scope.
server.py:584-632 — Razorpay create-order correctly branches between real and mock based on env vars; real path verified to return mock=false and proper Razorpay order_id.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 new tests passed; iteration_2 backend baseline of 33/33 unchanged)

seed_data_creation: Created phone-OTP test user +919999900099 (name 'Test', city 'Mumbai') and an application against the first paid event in the catalog. Did not call /payments/verify (per request — no fake signature).

Real Razorpay test keys (rzp_test_SoPqiOUiKGle8u) are wired and produce real order_ids — when verifying payments, the signature MUST be valid; sending mock=true now requires keys to be absent or backend will still try to validate. rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Google OAuth backend endpoint behaves exactly as the main agent intended: 400 for missing/empty session_id, 401 for invalid Google session (upstream 404 translated), 422 for missing pydantic field. No 500s observed.
